title: F1x4 codon frequencies
description: Construct frequencies on a triplet alphabet, including a codon alphabet, from a single set of nucleotide frequencies. The frequency of ijk is proportional to pi[i]*pi[j]*pi[k]. Frequencies are normalized over the supplied alphabet; for codon alphabets, stop codons are excluded.
